title: STORY TIME: My paranormal encounters - Spooky Halloween anecdotes
summary: A Halloween story time in which NH tells two personal paranormal anecdotes: a haunted laundromat in the North Tower of his first American university dorm (a former hospital), and a childhood expedition past a forbidden tree-trunk wall in his ancestral European mountains where he and his cousin saw a large black creature.
claims: NH describes himself as fairly skeptical, not really believing in ghosts, yet unable to rationally explain these two experiences
He first came to America to study about five to six years earlier; his university dorm was a set of bare concrete towers resembling the projects he grew up in for 20 years

In the dorm's North Tower basement laundromat, washing machines slammed shut, locked and ran by themselves; he later learned the tower was built on a former hospital ward where the dying were kept and was known to be haunted
He walked back from the gym at night to his tower during his college years
He spent two months every year as a child in his ancestors' remote mountain village, which he calls the best months of his life as a city kid

As a child he and his cousin crossed a forbidden tree-trunk wall in the forest, saw unexplained moving trees, a strange water bug and a large black creature, and fled; it gave him recurring nightmares
He was already nearsighted as a child
